description: This script contains functions for managing boot partitions, UUID retrieval, mounting and copying configuration files, and performing system upgrades specifically for i.MX-based devices in an OpenWrt environment.

methods.name: rootpartuuid
methods.description: Retrieves the UUID of the root partition from the kernel command line.

methods.name: bootdev_from_uuid
methods.description: Finds the device name of the boot partition matching a specific UUID.

methods.name: bootpart_from_uuid
methods.description: Gets the device path of the boot partition with a given UUID.

methods.name: rootpart_from_uuid
methods.description: Returns the device path of the root partition with a specific UUID.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_mount_boot
methods.description: Mounts the boot partition to /boot if not already mounted.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration to the boot partition.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs system upgrade by extracting kernel and root filesystem images from a tarball.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Pre-upgrade steps including resetting JFFS2, unmounting overlay.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_move_config
methods.description: Moves configuration files from the boot partition to root if present.
